background.value: Light grey (neutral, monochrome; must provide sufficient contrast to head and hair)

head_height.value: 29-34 mm (chin to crown), corresponding to 70-80% of image height

expression_restriction.value: Neutral expression, mouth closed, eyes open and looking directly at camera

glasses_policy.value: Glasses allowed if eyes fully visible, lenses must be clear (no tinting), no glare or reflections

headwear_policy.value: Not allowed; exceptions for religious or medical reasons (must not cover face or cast shadows; signed statement required)

face_visibility.value: Eyes open, looking directly at camera; face photographed from front; 5mm space between top of head and edge of photo

size.evidence: The official Swiss Federal Office of Police (fedpol) criteria document for passport photos specifies 35 x 45 mm. This was confirmed via the fedpol photo criteria PDF (fotomustertafel.pdf) and corroborated by multiple authoritative sources including passport-photo.online which cites the fedpol source directly. The claimed source URL (fedpol.admin.ch/de/beantragen) is a general application page rather than the specific photo criteria page, but the dimension itself is correct.
